title: S6b — Resolve image startup API requirement
description: S6a runtime comparison and pinned source inspection show omitted command starts a scratch shell, not OCI CMD; SDK 0.1.2 has no public image-config resolver or portable create-time workdir. Decide whether to adopt the explicit command/env/directory startup proposal in docs/image-startup.md and amend SPEC sections 9, 12.3, 36 and acceptance claims, or retain automatic startup and obtain a supported upstream/resolution boundary. Preserve no-local-Docker, exact workload, fail-closed and secret-safe requirements. Record the decision before P4 startup implementation.
acceptance_criteria: SPEC and provider-facing startup contract agree on a supported strategy; private adapter contracts are extended if translation is selected; P4 has no unresolved startup API requirement.

title: S6a — Validate image entrypoint and CMD startup
description: SPEC.md section 12.3 requires preserving the image workload. S4 left spec.command empty and proved only sandbox readiness; S5 supplied the canonical EchoEnv command explicitly. Compare omitted-command and explicit-command startup on SDK/gateway 0.1.2 with the pinned image and policy, requiring routed health and protocol evidence plus cleanup. Inspect the pinned public runtime contract for OCI ENTRYPOINT/CMD, working directory, and environment handling. Document a supported thin-adapter strategy and extend private adapter contracts if translation is necessary; never silently substitute a shell or hardcoded EchoEnv command. Preserve the no-local-Docker requirement for remote callers. If the selected upstream API cannot meet the requirement, record the exact limitation and proposed SPEC/API change before provider startup implementation.
notes: Completed comparison and pinned source inspection in docs/image-startup.md. Omitted-command Ready did not serve health; exact image CMD passed routed health, two episodes/four echo steps/state/ping-pong. Both original IDs deleted and absent; final workspace inventory empty. make check: lint/typecheck clean, 239 unit tests passed, 99.69% coverage. Two S6a runtime tests passed in 32.61s. Selected API cannot preserve automatic OCI startup; proposal remains pending S6b, now a P4 prerequisite. Production adapter and public API unchanged.
close_reason: Runtime comparison, cleanup, pinned contract findings and proposed SPEC/API strategy documented; make check and relevant integration comparison passed. S6b tracks required decision before P4.

title: S5a — Validate protocol on a remote gateway
description: SPEC.md sections 5.1, 14, and 41 require usable remote service routing. S5 established local HTTP/WebSocket/reset/step/state; no remote gateway is configured. Obtain an authorized remote OpenShell 0.1.2 gateway/workspace and a pullable immutable EchoEnv image compatible with its compute driver. Extend the opt-in probe beyond local image IDs, preserve TLS verification, test service authentication with an unmodified OpenEnv client, repeat reset/step/state and ping/pong, and verify cleanup. Record remote evidence in docs/protocol-spike.md; do not infer remote compatibility from the local VM run.
notes: Blocked: only the local openshell gateway at https://localhost:17670 is registered (openshell gateway list --output json). Need authorized remote gateway/workspace access and a pullable immutable image; checked-in sha256 ID exists only in the local Docker store.

Release checklist (all items remain unverified):

Use this compact checklist at the M3 gate; evidence should point to tests or
documentation rather than merely changing the box.

- ⬜ Existing OpenEnv clients need no source changes.
- ⬜ The environment runs inside OpenShell and is reachable only through its
  managed service route.
- ⬜ `/health`, `/ws`, `reset`, `step`, and `state` all work.
- ⬜ Normal close and every tested startup failure delete owned sandboxes.
- ⬜ `stop_container()` is idempotent and `keep_sandbox` is explicit.
- ⬜ Explicit policies are supported and never silently broadened.
- ⬜ Network and filesystem denials are demonstrated.
- ⬜ Unit tests require no OpenShell installation; real E2E tests are separate.
- ⬜ The README quickstart and canonical demo work from a clean environment.
- ⬜ Package, compatibility, typing, lint, test, and coverage checks pass.
acceptance_criteria:
Every acceptance criterion in §39 of `SPEC.md` is checked,
CI and E2E are green, the quickstart is reproducible, and no sandbox leaks in
success or failure tests.
